title: Factorization of the ordinary closure-line leg
statement: For prime l, finite E and scheme X with l invertible, the prescribed closureLineMap factors through the ordinary scalar extension of spRationalTwist.

source.place: paragraph (2), ordinary root-line scalar extension before direct image

proof.text: Choose compatible normalized rational root bases on a pro-etale cover and pass their maps through the sheafified coefficient colimit; the resulting module morphism has composite with the scalar-extension unit equal to the prescribed colimit leg.

mathlib_searches.query: factorization of closure colimit leg through scalar extension of a finite rational root line
mathlib_searches.results: No existing global module-sheaf theorem; use the normalized root diagram basis.

mathlib_searches.query: colimit leg factors through extendScalars module morphism
mathlib_searches.results: No matching theorem for the pro-etale Tate line.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalClosure_ordinaryLine_factor
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (_hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) :
    ∃ f : (Mod.extendScalars
        (coefficientMap (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl l E) X)).obj
          (spRationalTwist X l E) ⟶ spQbarTwist X l,
      Mod.extendUnitHom (coefficientMap (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl l E) X)
          (spRationalTwist X l E) ≫ f.hom = closureLineMap l E X
